canonical_interface_proposal.authority: local catalogue convention, not an official LeetCode signature

title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

constraints.structure: A strictly ascending array rotated right between 1 and n times, inclusive.

local_policy_proposal.values: JSON integer/string/array value transport; reject booleans as integers, NaN and infinity.
local_policy_proposal.effects: Review and freeze input-preservation and return-alias policy separately before qualification; do not infer from functional outputs.
local_policy_proposal.unicode: Only 833 and 916 have string inputs; their published alphabet excludes non-ASCII characters.
local_policy_proposal.numeric: All specified input integers and result integers fit exactly in JavaScript Number; Python integers preserve the same mathematical values.

test_plan: For every rotation of each independently chosen strictly increasing small array, expected minimum stays fixed.
Use n=5000 distinct consecutive values inside bounds; include pivot at either end. Audit logarithmic search separately from finite verdicts.
promotion: Contract review plus separately bound source/interface/runtime/effect/test receipts required; no compatibility probe upgrade.
